title: You're Probably Paying For Subscriptions You Forgot About

lines: Quick question. How much do you spend on subscriptions every month?
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail on a couch looking at her phone with a puzzled face, cozy room, vertical composition

lines: In one survey, people guessed around eighty six dollars.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail confidently holding up her hand guessing, thought bubble with coins, vertical composition

lines: The real average? Over two hundred dollars a month.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail shocked looking at a long receipt unrolling to the floor, vertical composition

lines: Free trials that quietly turned into payments. Apps you opened once. A gym you forgot.
scenes.img: a messy desk with a phone showing many app icons, a dusty gym bag and a forgotten tablet, vertical composition

lines: Here's the ten minute fix. Open your bank app and look for recurring charges from the last three months.
scenes.img: {HERO} on a couch scrolling through a banking app on his phone, focused face, vertical composition

lines: For each one, ask. Would I sign up for this again today? If not, cancel it right now.
scenes.img: {HERO} tapping a cancel button on his phone with a satisfied smile, small sparkles, vertical composition

lines: Cutting just fifty dollars a month puts six hundred dollars a year back in your pocket.
scenes.img: {HERO} dropping coins into a big glass jar on a kitchen counter, happy, vertical composition

lines: Go check yours tonight. Follow for one simple money move every day!
scenes.img: {HERO} giving a thumbs up and smiling in a cozy room, vertical composition
